answer: The saffron multiplier is published, charged in spiral, and willow lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 9 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 3698 identities would post 4811 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
